decision_conditions: <p><span style="line-height:115%">The proposed first floor rear extension, given its overlap with the existing larger rear dormer,&nbsp;would result in an inappropriate and poorly designed roof form that would be an unduly obtrusive,&nbsp;awkward and incongruous addition to the original dwellinghouse, failing to respect the character and proportions of the dwellinghouse and the visual amenities of the locality. The proposal would therefore be contrary to the high quality design aspiration of the National Planning Policy Framework (2024), Policy D3.D(1), (11) and (12)&nbsp;of The London Plan (2021), Policy CS1.B of the</span><span style="font-size:11.0pt"><span style="line-height:107%">&nbsp;Harrow Core Strategy (2012),&nbsp;</span></span><span style="line-height:115%">Policy DM1 A, B (a), (b) and (c) of the Development Management Policies Local Plan document (2013) and the relevant provisions of the adopted Harrow Supplementary Planning Document Residential Design Guide (2010).</span></p>

<p><span style="line-height:115%">The proposed first floor rear extension, by reason of its depth and siting, would be visually intrusive, and&nbsp;</span><span aptos="">would&nbsp;result in&nbsp;overshadowing impacts,</span><span style="line-height:115%"> with regard to the outlook from the first floor windows of the attached&nbsp;property no. 62 </span><span aptos="">Kenilworth Avenue. </span><span style="line-height:115%">The proposal would therefore result in unacceptable impacts on the amenities of this neighbouring property, contrary to Policy D3.D(7)&nbsp;of The London Plan (2021), </span><span style="line-height:115%">Policy DM1 of the Development Management Policies Local Plan document (2013) and the relevant provisions of the adopted Harrow Supplementary Planning Document Residential Design Guide (2010).</span></p>
description: First floor rear extension, External alterations
